run_AerialMegaDepthWAI_dataset: run the AerialMegaDepthWAI dataset to load and iterate over aerial scene views with images and depthmaps
create_AerialMegaDepthWAI_instance: create an AerialMegaDepthWAI dataset instance with a specific split, resolution, and number of views
review_get_views_method: review the _get_views method that samples covisible views from a scene and loads image depth and pose data
review_load_data_method: review the _load_data method that loads precomputed scene list metadata from numpy files for a given split
run_cli_viz: run the module CLI with --viz to visualize AerialMegaDepth dataset samples using Rerun 3D viewer
